episodes.short_title: There's more to life than being happy
episodes.summary: 通过研究和采访，她总结出有意义人生的四根支柱：归属感、目标、超越体验和重新讲述自己的故事。

episodes.short_title: What really matters at the end of life
episodes.summary: 一场高压电事故让演讲者过早直面死亡，也让他后来成为临终关怀医生。他反思医疗系统常把疾病放在中心，却忽略了人的感受。
哈佛追踪724名男性长达75年，发现真正让人健康长寿、头脑清醒的是值得信赖的亲密关系。

episodes.short_title: The Unstoppable Power of Letting Go
episodes.summary: 一次经历让她终于决定放手，离开旧生活，也遇见了真正愿意靠近她的人。
人总会高估自己的好结果，低估坏事发生在自己身上的概率。乐观能让人更幸福、更有动力，但如果完全忽视风险，也会带来错误决策。

subtitles.english: Sooner or later, I think we all wonder:

subtitles.ipa: suːnɚɹ ɔːɹ leɪɾɚ, aɪ θɪŋk wiː ɔːl wʌndɚ:

subtitles.english: Is there more to life than being happy?

subtitles.ipa: ænd wʌts ðə dɪfɹəns bᵻtwiːn biːɪŋ hæpi

subtitles.english: and having meaning in life?

subtitles.ipa: ðæts ðə stɔːɹi hiː tɛlz hɪmsɛlf.

subtitles.english: That's the power of meaning.
subtitles.chinese: 这就是意义的力量。
subtitles.ipa: ðæts ðə paʊɚɹ ʌv miːnɪŋ.

subtitles.english: Happiness comes and goes.
subtitles.chinese: 快乐来来去去。
subtitles.ipa: hæpɪnəs kʌmz ænd ɡoʊz.

subtitles.english: But when life is really good
subtitles.chinese: 但当生活真的很美好时，
subtitles.ipa: bʌt wɛn laɪf ɪz ɹiəli ɡʊd

subtitles.english: and when things are really bad,
subtitles.chinese: 也当一切真的很糟糕时，
subtitles.ipa: ænd wɛn θɪŋz ɑːɹ ɹiəli bæd,

subtitles.english: having meaning gives you something to hold on to.
subtitles.chinese: 拥有意义，会让你有所依靠。
subtitles.ipa: hævɪŋ miːnɪŋ ɡɪvz juː sʌmθɪŋ tə hoʊld ɔn tuː.

episode.short_title: What really matters at the end of life
episode.summary: 一场高压电事故让演讲者过早直面死亡，也让他后来成为临终关怀医生。他反思医疗系统常把疾病放在中心，却忽略了人的感受。

subtitles.english: Takes a licking!
subtitles.chinese: 真是经得起折腾！
subtitles.ipa: teɪks ɐ lɪkɪŋ!

subtitles.english: Why?
subtitles.chinese: 为什么呢？
subtitles.ipa: waɪ?

subtitles.english: and that's something we can all say one way or another.
subtitles.chinese: 而这件事，我们每个人都能以某种方式说出口。
subtitles.ipa: ænd ðæts sʌmθɪŋ wiː kæn ɔːl seɪ wʌn weɪ ɔːɹ ɐnʌðɚ.

subtitles.english: I got to redesign my life around this fact,
subtitles.chinese: 我得以围绕这个事实重新设计我的人生，
subtitles.ipa: aɪ ɡɑːt tə ɹiːdɪzaɪn maɪ laɪf ɚɹaʊnd ðɪs fækt,

subtitles.english: and I tell you it has been a liberation
subtitles.chinese: 我可以告诉你，意识到这一点是一种解放：
subtitles.ipa: ænd aɪ tɛl juː ɪt hæzbiːn ɐ lɪbɚɹeɪʃən

subtitles.english: to realize you can always find a shock of beauty or meaning
subtitles.chinese: 在你剩下的人生里，你永远可以找到一阵突如其来的美或意义，
subtitles.ipa: tə ɹiːəlaɪz juː kæn ɔːlweɪz faɪnd ɐ ʃɑːk ʌv bjuːɾi ɔːɹ miːnɪŋ

subtitles.english: in what life you have left,
subtitles.chinese: 无论那生命还剩多少，
subtitles.ipa: ɪn wʌt laɪf juː hæv lɛft,

subtitles.english: like that snowball lasting for a perfect moment,
subtitles.chinese: 就像那个雪球，在一个完美的瞬间存在着，
subtitles.ipa: laɪk ðæt snoʊbɔːl læstɪŋ fɚɹə pɜːfɛkt moʊmənt,
subtitles.english_html: likethatsnowballlastingforaperfectmoment,

subtitles.english: all the while melting away.
subtitles.chinese: 同时又一直在融化消失。
subtitles.ipa: ɔːl ðə waɪl mɛltɪŋ ɐweɪ.

subtitles.english: If we love such moments ferociously,
subtitles.chinese: 如果我们能够炽烈地爱着这样的瞬间，
subtitles.ipa: ɪf wiː lʌv sʌtʃ moʊmənts fəɹoʊʃəsli,
subtitles.english_html: Ifwelovesuchmomentsferociously,

subtitles.english: then maybe we can learn to live well --
subtitles.chinese: 那么也许我们就能学会好好活着——
subtitles.ipa: ðɛn meɪbiː wiː kæn lɜːn tə lɪv wɛl

subtitles.english: not in spite of death,
subtitles.chinese: 不是尽管有死亡，
subtitles.ipa: nɑːt ɪn spaɪt ʌv dɛθ,

subtitles.english: but because of it.
subtitles.chinese: 而是因为有死亡。
subtitles.ipa: bʌt bɪkʌz ʌv ɪt.

subtitles.english: Let death be what takes us,
subtitles.chinese: 让死亡带走我们，
subtitles.ipa: lɛt dɛθ biː wʌt teɪks ʌs,

subtitles.english: not lack of imagination.
subtitles.chinese: 而不是让想象力的匮乏带走我们。
subtitles.ipa: nɑːt læk ʌv ɪmædʒᵻneɪʃən.

subtitles.english: Well, we all need a reason to wake up.
subtitles.chinese: 每个人都需要一个早晨醒来的理由。
subtitles.ipa: wɛl, wiː ɔːl niːd ɐ ɹiːzən tə weɪk ʌp.

subtitles.english: For me, it just took 11,000 volts.
subtitles.chinese: 而对我来说，这个理由足足用了11000伏电压才让我明白。
subtitles.ipa: fɔːɹ miː, ɪt dʒʌst tʊk ɪlɛvən,ziəɹoʊziəɹoʊ ziəɹoʊ voʊlts.

subtitles.english: I know you're too polite to ask,
subtitles.chinese: 我知道你们太有礼貌，不会主动问我，
subtitles.ipa: aɪ noʊ jʊɹ tuː pəlaɪt tʊ æsk,

subtitles.english: so I will tell you.
subtitles.chinese: 所以我自己来告诉你们。
subtitles.ipa: soʊ aɪ wɪl tɛl juː.

subtitles.english: One night, sophomore year of college,
subtitles.chinese: 大学二年级那年，
subtitles.ipa: wʌn naɪt, sɑːfəmɔːɹ jɪɹ ʌv kɑːlɪdʒ,

subtitles.english: just back from Thanksgiving holiday,
subtitles.chinese: 感恩节假期刚结束，
subtitles.ipa: dʒʌst bæk fɹʌm θæŋksɡɪvɪŋ hɑːlɪdeɪ,

subtitles.english: a few of my friends and I were horsing around,
subtitles.chinese: 我和几个朋友正在打闹胡闹，
subtitles.ipa: ɐ fjuː ʌv maɪ fɹɛndz ænd aɪ wɜː hɔːɹsɪŋ ɚɹaʊnd,

subtitles.english: and we decided to climb atop a parked commuter train.
subtitles.chinese: 然后我们决定爬上一列停着不动的通勤列车车顶。
subtitles.ipa: ænd wiː dᵻsaɪdᵻd tə klaɪm ɐtɑːp ɐ pɑːɹkt kəmjuːɾɚ tɹeɪn.
subtitles.english_html: andwedecidedtoclimbatopaparkedcommutertrain.

subtitles.english: It was just sitting there, with the wires that run overhead.
subtitles.chinese: 它就停在那里，上方架着供电电线。
subtitles.ipa: ɪt wʌz dʒʌst sɪɾɪŋ ðɛɹ, wɪððə waɪɚz ðæt ɹʌn oʊvɚhɛd.

subtitles.english: Somehow, that seemed like a great idea at the time.
subtitles.chinese: 不知怎么的，当时我们觉得这主意特别棒。
subtitles.ipa: sʌmhaʊ, ðæt siːmd laɪk ɐ ɡɹeɪt aɪdiə æt ðə taɪm.

subtitles.english: We'd certainly done stupider things.
subtitles.chinese: 毕竟我们以前干过更蠢的事。
subtitles.ipa: wiːd sɜːʔn̩li dʌn stuːpɪdɚ θɪŋz.

subtitles.english: I scurried up the ladder on the back,
subtitles.chinese: 我顺着后面的梯子飞快爬了上去，
subtitles.ipa: aɪ skɜːɹid ʌp ðə lædɚɹ ɔnðə bæk,

subtitles.english: and when I stood up,
subtitles.chinese: 就在我站起身的时候，
subtitles.ipa: ænd wɛn aɪ stʊd ʌp,

subtitles.english: the electrical current entered my arm,
subtitles.chinese: 电流从我的手臂进入身体，
subtitles.ipa: ðɪ ᵻlɛktɹɪkəl kɜːɹənt ɛntɚd maɪ ɑːɹm,

subtitles.english: blew down and out my feet, and that was that.
subtitles.chinese: 一路轰穿我的身体，从双脚冲出体外，一切就在那一刻改变了。
subtitles.ipa: bluː daʊn ænd aʊt maɪ fiːt, ænd ðæt wʌz ðæt.

subtitles.english: Would you believe that watch still works?
subtitles.chinese: 你们敢信吗？那块手表居然还能走。
subtitles.ipa: wʊd juː bᵻliːv ðæt wɑːtʃ stɪl wɜːks?

subtitles.english: My father wears it now in solidarity.
subtitles.chinese: 现在我父亲戴着它，以示与我同在。
subtitles.ipa: maɪ fɑːðɚ wɛɹz ɪt naʊ ɪn sɑːlɪdæɹᵻɾi.

subtitles.english: That night began my formal relationship with death -- my death --
subtitles.chinese: 那个夜晚，开启了我与死亡——与我自己的死亡——正式的关系。
subtitles.ipa: ðæt naɪt bɪɡæn maɪ fɔːɹməl ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪp wɪð dɛθ maɪ dɛθ
subtitles.english_html: Thatnightbeganmyformalrelationshipwithdeath--mydeath--

subtitles.english: and it also began my long run as a patient.
subtitles.chinese: 同时，也开始了我漫长的病人生活。
subtitles.ipa: ænd ɪɾ ɔːlsoʊ bɪɡæn maɪ lɔŋ ɹʌn æz ɐ peɪʃənt.

subtitles.english: It's a good word.
subtitles.chinese: 这是个很有意思的词。
subtitles.ipa: ɪts ɐ ɡʊd wɜːd.

subtitles.english: It means one who suffers.
subtitles.chinese: 它的意思是承受痛苦的人。
subtitles.ipa: ɪt miːnz wʌn huː sʌfɚz.

subtitles.english: So I guess we're all patients.
subtitles.chinese: 这么说来，我想我们每个人都是病人。
subtitles.ipa: soʊ aɪ ɡɛs wɪɹ ɔːl peɪʃənts.

subtitles.english: Now, the American health care system
subtitles.chinese: 如今，美国医疗体系
subtitles.ipa: naʊ, ðɪ ɐmɛɹɪkən hɛlθ kɛɹ sɪstəm

subtitles.english: has more than its fair share of dysfunction --
subtitles.chinese: 存在着不少问题和失灵之处——
subtitles.ipa: hɐz mɔːɹ ðɐn ɪts fɛɹ ʃɛɹ ʌv dɪsfʌŋkʃən

subtitles.english: to match its brilliance, to be sure.
subtitles.chinese: 当然，与它卓越的一面同样突出。
subtitles.ipa: tə mætʃ ɪts bɹɪliəns, təbi ʃʊɹ.

subtitles.english: I'm a physician now, a hospice and palliative medicine doc,
subtitles.chinese: 现在我是一名医生，一名临终关怀与姑息治疗医生，
subtitles.ipa: aɪm ɐ fɪzɪʃən naʊ, ɐ hɑːspɪs ænd pæliətɪv mɛdəsən dɑːk,

subtitles.english: so I've seen care from both sides.
subtitles.chinese: 因此我从两边都见识过医疗体系。
subtitles.ipa: soʊ aɪv siːn kɛɹ fɹʌm boʊθ saɪdz.

subtitles.english: And believe me: almost everyone who goes into healthcare
subtitles.chinese: 相信我：几乎所有投身医疗行业的人
subtitles.ipa: ænd bᵻliːv miː: ɔːlmoʊst ɛvɹɪwʌn huː ɡoʊz ɪntʊ hɛlθkɛɹ

subtitles.english: really means well -- I mean, truly.
subtitles.chinese: 本意都是真心想帮助别人——真的如此。
subtitles.ipa: ɹiəli miːnz wɛl aɪ miːn, tɹuːli.
subtitles.english_html: reallymeanswell--Imean,truly.

subtitles.english: But we who work in it are also unwitting agents
subtitles.chinese: 但我们这些身处其中的人，也在不知不觉间成为了
subtitles.ipa: bʌt wiː huː wɜːk ɪn ɪɾ ɑːɹ ɔːlsoʊ ʌnwɪɾɪŋ eɪdʒənts

subtitles.english: for a system that too often does not serve.
subtitles.chinese: 一个常常无法真正服务于人的系统的执行者。
subtitles.ipa: fɚɹə sɪstəm ðæt tuː ɔfən dʌznɑːt sɜːv.

subtitles.english: Well, there's actually a pretty easy answer to that question,
subtitles.chinese: 其实这个问题的答案相当简单，
subtitles.ipa: wɛl, ðɛɹz æktʃuːəli ɐ pɹɪɾi iːzi ænsɚ tə ðæt kwɛstʃən,

subtitles.english: and it explains a lot:
subtitles.chinese: 而且它能解释很多事情：
subtitles.ipa: ænd ɪɾ ɛkspleɪnz ɐ lɑːt:

subtitles.english: because healthcare was designed with diseases, not people, at its center.
subtitles.chinese: 因为医疗体系的设计核心是疾病，而不是人。
subtitles.ipa: bɪkʌz hɛlθkɛɹ wʌz dɪzaɪnd wɪð dɪziːzᵻz, nɑːt piːpəl, æɾ ɪts sɛntɚ.

subtitles.english: Which is to say, of course, it was badly designed.
subtitles.chinese: 换句话说，它从一开始就设计得不够好。
subtitles.ipa: wɪtʃ ɪz tə seɪ, ʌv kɔːɹs, ɪt wʌz bædli dɪzaɪnd.
subtitles.english_html: Whichistosay,ofcourse,itwasbadlydesigned.

subtitles.english: And nowhere are the effects of bad design more heartbreaking
subtitles.chinese: 而糟糕设计造成的后果，最令人心碎的地方，
subtitles.ipa: ænd noʊwɛɹ ɑːɹ ðɪ ɪfɛkts ʌv bæd dɪzaɪn mɔːɹ hɑːɹtbɹeɪkɪŋ

subtitles.english: or the opportunity for good design more compelling
subtitles.chinese: 以及优秀设计最能发挥价值的地方，
subtitles.ipa: ɔːɹ ðɪ ɑːpɚtuːnᵻɾi fɔːɹ ɡʊd dɪzaɪn mɔːɹ kəmpɛlɪŋ

subtitles.english: than at the end of life,
subtitles.chinese: 莫过于生命的终点。
subtitles.ipa: ðɐn æt ðɪ ɛnd ʌv laɪf,

subtitles.english: where things are so distilled and concentrated.
subtitles.chinese: 因为在那里，一切都被浓缩到了极致。
subtitles.ipa: wɛɹ θɪŋz ɑːɹ soʊ dɪstɪld ænd kɑːnsəntɹeɪɾᵻd.

subtitles.english: There are no do-overs.
subtitles.chinese: 没有重来的机会。
subtitles.ipa: ðɛɹɑːɹ noʊ duːoʊvɚz.

subtitles.english: My purpose today is to reach out across disciplines
subtitles.chinese: 今天我想跨越不同领域，
subtitles.ipa: maɪ pɜːpəs tədeɪ ɪz tə ɹiːtʃ aʊt əkɹɑːs dɪsɪplɪnz
subtitles.english_html: Mypurposetodayistoreachoutacrossdisciplines

subtitles.english: and invite design thinking into this big conversation.
subtitles.chinese: 邀请设计思维加入这场重要的讨论。
subtitles.ipa: ænd ɪnvaɪt dɪzaɪn θɪŋkɪŋ ɪntʊ ðɪs bɪɡ kɑːnvɚseɪʃən.

subtitles.english: That is, to bring intention and creativity
subtitles.chinese: 也就是说，把有意识的思考与创造力
subtitles.ipa: ðæt ɪz, tə bɹɪŋ ɪntɛnʃən ænd kɹiːeɪtɪvᵻɾi
subtitles.english_html: Thatis,tobringintentionandcreativity

subtitles.english: to the experience of dying.
subtitles.chinese: 带入死亡这段经历之中。
subtitles.ipa: tə ðɪ ɛkspiəɹɪəns ʌv daɪɪŋ.

subtitles.english: We have a monumental opportunity in front of us,
subtitles.chinese: 摆在我们面前的是一个巨大的机会，
subtitles.ipa: wiː hæv ɐ mɑːnjuːmɛntəl ɑːpɚtuːnᵻɾi ɪn fɹʌnt ʌv ʌs,

subtitles.english: before one of the few universal issues
subtitles.chinese: 面对这个少数几个人人都会经历的问题之一，
subtitles.ipa: bᵻfɔːɹ wʌn ʌvðə fjuː juːnɪvɜːsəl ɪʃuːz
subtitles.english_html: beforeoneofthefewuniversalissues

subtitles.english: as individuals as well as a civil society:
subtitles.chinese: 无论作为个人还是作为社会整体：
subtitles.ipa: æz ɪndᵻvɪdʒuːəlz æz wɛl æz ɐ sɪvəl səsaɪəɾi:
subtitles.english_html: asindividualsaswellasacivilsociety:

subtitles.english: to rethink and redesign how it is we die.
subtitles.chinese: 重新思考并重新设计我们的死亡方式。
subtitles.ipa: tə ɹᵻθɪŋk ænd ɹiːdɪzaɪn haʊ ɪɾ ɪz wiː daɪ.

subtitles.english: So let's begin at the end.
subtitles.chinese: 那么，就让我们从终点开始谈起。
subtitles.ipa: soʊ lɛts bɪɡɪn æt ðɪ ɛnd.

subtitles.english: For most people, the scariest thing about death isn't being dead,
subtitles.chinese: 对大多数人来说，死亡最可怕的并不是死去，
subtitles.ipa: fɔːɹ moʊst piːpəl, ðə skɛɹiɪst θɪŋ ɐbaʊt dɛθ ɪzənt biːɪŋ dɛd,

subtitles.english: it's dying, suffering.
subtitles.chinese: 而是死亡的过程，是痛苦。
subtitles.ipa: ɪts daɪɪŋ, sʌfɚɹɪŋ.

subtitles.english: It's a key distinction.
subtitles.chinese: 这是一个关键区别。
subtitles.ipa: ɪts ɐ kiː dɪstɪŋkʃən.

subtitles.english: To get underneath this, it can be very helpful
subtitles.chinese: 为了真正理解这一点，
subtitles.ipa: tə ɡɛt ʌndɚniːθ ðɪs, ɪt kæn biː vɛɹi hɛlpfəl

subtitles.english: to tease out suffering which is necessary as it is,
subtitles.chinese: 把那些不可避免的痛苦
subtitles.ipa: tə tiːz aʊt sʌfɚɹɪŋ wɪtʃ ɪz nɛsᵻsɚɹi æzɪtɪz,

subtitles.english: from suffering we can change.
subtitles.chinese: 和那些可以改变的痛苦区分开来会很有帮助。
subtitles.ipa: fɹʌm sʌfɚɹɪŋ wiː kæn tʃeɪndʒ.

subtitles.english: The former is a natural, essential part of life, part of the deal,
subtitles.chinese: 前者是生命自然且必不可少的一部分，是人生的一部分。
subtitles.ipa: ðə fɔːɹmɚɹ ɪz ɐ nætʃɚɹəl, ᵻsɛnʃəl pɑːɹt ʌv laɪf, pɑːɹt ʌvðə diːl,
subtitles.english_html: Theformerisanatural,essentialpartoflife,partofthedeal,

subtitles.english: and to this we are called to make space, adjust, grow.
subtitles.chinese: 面对它，我们需要学会接纳、调整并成长。
subtitles.ipa: ænd tə ðɪs wiː ɑːɹ kɔːld tə meɪk speɪs, ɐdʒʌst, ɡɹoʊ.
subtitles.english_html: andtothiswearecalledtomakespace,adjust,grow.

subtitles.english: It can be really good to realize forces larger than ourselves.
subtitles.chinese: 意识到有些力量远比我们自身更庞大，其实是一件好事。
subtitles.ipa: ɪt kæn biː ɹiəli ɡʊd tə ɹiːəlaɪz fɔːɹsᵻz lɑːɹdʒɚ ðɐn aʊɚsɛlvz.
subtitles.english_html: Itcanbereallygoodtorealizeforceslargerthanourselves.

subtitles.ipa: wʌn pɹɛzɪdənt ʌvðə juːnaɪɾᵻd steɪts.

subtitles.english: Some developed alcoholism. A few developed schizophrenia.

subtitles.ipa: sʌm dɪvɛləpt ælkəhoʊlɪzəm. ɐ fjuː dɪvɛləpt skɪtsəfɹɛniə.

subtitles.english: Some climbed the social ladder
subtitles.chinese: 有些人沿着社会阶梯一路向上，

subtitles.chinese: 也有些人走上了完全相反的道路。

subtitles.english_html: andsomemadethatjourneyintheoppositedirection.

subtitles.english: The founders of this study
subtitles.chinese: 这项研究的创始人
subtitles.ipa: ðə faʊndɚz ʌv ðɪs stʌdi

subtitles.english: have imagined that I would be standing here today, 75 years later,
subtitles.chinese: 也不会想到，75年后的今天，我会站在这里，
subtitles.ipa: hæv ɪmædʒɪnd ðæt aɪ wʊd biː stændɪŋ hɪɹ tədeɪ, sɛvənti faɪv jɪɹz leɪɾɚ,

subtitles.chinese: 告诉大家这项研究仍在继续。
subtitles.ipa: tɛlɪŋ juː ðætðə stʌdi stɪl kəntɪnjuːz.

subtitles.english: Every two years, our patient and dedicated research staff
subtitles.chinese: 每隔两年，我们耐心而敬业的研究人员
subtitles.ipa: ɛvɹi tuː jɪɹz, aʊɚ peɪʃənt ænd dɛdᵻkeɪɾᵻd ɹᵻsɜːtʃ stæf
subtitles.english_html: Everytwoyears,ourpatientanddedicatedresearchstaff

subtitles.english: calls up our men and asks them if we can send them
subtitles.chinese: 都会给这些男性打电话，询问是否可以再给他们寄去
subtitles.ipa: kɔːlz ʌp aʊɚ mɛn ænd æsks ðɛm ɪf wiː kæn sɛnd ðɛm

subtitles.english: yet one more set of questions about their lives.
subtitles.chinese: 一套关于他们生活的调查问题。
subtitles.ipa: jɛt wʌn mɔːɹ sɛt ʌv kwɛstʃənz ɐbaʊt ðɛɹ laɪvz.

subtitles.english: Many of the inner city Boston men ask us,
subtitles.chinese: 许多来自Boston市中心贫困社区的男性会问我们：
subtitles.ipa: mɛnɪəv ðɪ ɪnɚ sɪɾi bɔstən mɛn æsk ʌs,
subtitles.english_html: ManyoftheinnercityBostonmenaskus,

subtitles.english: "Why do you keep wanting to study me? My life just isn't that interesting."
subtitles.chinese: “你们为什么总想研究我？我的人生根本没那么有意思。”
subtitles.ipa: "waɪ duː juː kiːp wɔntɪŋ tə stʌdi miː? maɪ laɪf dʒʌst ɪzənt ðæt ɪntɹɛstɪŋ."

subtitles.english: The Harvard men never ask that question.
subtitles.chinese: 哈佛的那组人从来不会问这个问题。
subtitles.ipa: ðə hɑːɹvɚd mɛn nɛvɚɹ æsk ðæt kwɛstʃən.

subtitles.english: To get the clearest picture of these lives,
subtitles.chinese: 为了尽可能清楚地了解他们的人生，
subtitles.ipa: tə ɡɛt ðə klɪɹɪst pɪktʃɚɹ ʌv ðiːz laɪvz,

subtitles.english: we don't just send them questionnaires.
subtitles.chinese: 我们并不只是给他们寄调查问卷。
subtitles.ipa: wiː doʊnt dʒʌst sɛnd ðɛm kwɛstʃənɛɹz.

subtitles.english: We interview them in their living rooms.
subtitles.chinese: 我们会坐在他们的客厅里采访他们。
subtitles.ipa: wiː ɪntɚvjuː ðɛm ɪn ðɛɹ lɪvɪŋ ɹuːmz.

subtitles.english: We get their medical records from their doctors.
subtitles.chinese: 我们会从他们的医生那里获取病历。
subtitles.ipa: wiː ɡɛt ðɛɹ mɛdɪkəl ɹɛkɚdz fɹʌm ðɛɹ dɑːktɚz.

subtitles.english: We draw their blood, we scan their brains,
subtitles.chinese: 我们会给他们抽血，扫描他们的大脑，
subtitles.ipa: wiː dɹɔː ðɛɹ blʌd, wiː skæn ðɛɹ bɹeɪnz,

subtitles.english: we talk to their children.
subtitles.chinese: 还会与他们的子女交谈。
subtitles.ipa: wiː tɔːk tə ðɛɹ tʃɪldɹən.

subtitles.english: We videotape them talking with their wives about their deepest concerns.
subtitles.chinese: 我们会录下他们与妻子谈论内心最深层忧虑的过程。
subtitles.ipa: wiː vɪdɪoʊteɪp ðɛm tɔːkɪŋ wɪð ðɛɹ waɪvz ɐbaʊt ðɛɹ diːpɪst kənsɜːnz.

subtitles.english: And when, about a decade ago, we finally asked the wives
subtitles.chinese: 大约十年前，我们终于询问这些妻子，
subtitles.ipa: ænd wɛn, ɐbaʊt ɐ dɛkeɪd ɐɡoʊ, wiː faɪnəli æskt ðə waɪvz

subtitles.english: if they would join us as members of the study,
subtitles.chinese: 是否愿意也作为研究对象加入我们时，
subtitles.ipa: ɪf ðeɪ wʊd dʒɔɪn ʌs æz mɛmbɚz ʌvðə stʌdi,

subtitles.english: many of the women said, "You know, it's about time."
subtitles.chinese: 许多女性都说：“你们早就该这么做了。”
subtitles.ipa: mɛnɪəv ðə wɪmɪn sɛd, "juː noʊ, ɪts ɐbaʊt taɪm."

subtitles.english: So what have we learned?
subtitles.chinese: 那么，我们究竟学到了什么？
subtitles.ipa: soʊ wʌt hæv wiː lɜːnd?

subtitles.english: What are the lessons that come from the tens of thousands of pages
subtitles.chinese: 我们积累了数以万计页面的资料，
subtitles.ipa: wʌt ɑːɹ ðə lɛsənz ðæt kʌm fɹʌmðə tɛnz ʌv θaʊzəndz ʌv peɪdʒᵻz

subtitles.english: of information that we've generated
subtitles.chinese: 从这些资料中得到的经验和启示
subtitles.ipa: ʌv ɪnfɚmeɪʃən ðæt wiːv dʒɛnɚɹeɪɾᵻd

subtitles.english: on these lives?
subtitles.chinese: 究竟是什么？
subtitles.ipa: ɔn ðiːz laɪvz?

subtitles.english: Well, the lessons aren't about wealth or fame or working harder and harder.
subtitles.chinese: 这些启示与财富、名声或拼命工作无关。
subtitles.ipa: wɛl, ðə lɛsənz ɑːɹnt ɐbaʊt wɛlθ ɔːɹ feɪm ɔːɹ wɜːkɪŋ hɑːɹdɚ ænd hɑːɹdɚ.

subtitles.english: The clearest message that we get from this 75-year study is this:
subtitles.chinese: 这项持续75年的研究传达出的最明确的信息是：
subtitles.ipa: ðə klɪɹɪst mɛsɪdʒ ðæt wiː ɡɛt fɹʌm ðɪs sɛvənti faɪvjɪɹ stʌdi ɪz ðɪs:

subtitles.english: Good relationships keep us happier and healthier. Period.
subtitles.chinese: 良好的人际关系会让我们更幸福、更健康。就是这么简单。
subtitles.ipa: ɡʊd ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪps kiːp ʌs hæpɪɚ ænd hɛlθiɚ. piəɹɪəd.
subtitles.english_html: Goodrelationshipskeepushappierandhealthier.Period.

subtitles.english: We've learned three big lessons about relationships.
subtitles.chinese: 关于人际关系，我们得出了三条重要结论。
subtitles.ipa: wiːv lɜːnd θɹiː bɪɡ lɛsənz ɐbaʊt ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪps.

subtitles.english: The first is that social connections are really good for us,
subtitles.chinese: 第一，社会联系确实对我们非常有益，
subtitles.ipa: ðə fɜːst ɪz ðæt soʊʃəl kənɛkʃənz ɑːɹ ɹiəli ɡʊd fɔːɹ ʌs,

subtitles.english: and that loneliness kills.
subtitles.chinese: 而孤独则会致命。
subtitles.ipa: ænd ðæt loʊnlinəs kɪlz.

subtitles.english: It turns out that people who are more socially connected
subtitles.chinese: 事实证明，与他人拥有更多社会联系的人，
subtitles.ipa: ɪt tɜːnz aʊt ðæt piːpəl huː ɑːɹ mɔːɹ soʊʃəli kənɛktᵻd

subtitles.english: to family, to friends, to community,
subtitles.chinese: 无论是与家人、朋友还是社区保持联系，
subtitles.ipa: tə fæmɪli, tə fɹɛndz, tə kəmjuːnᵻɾi,

subtitles.english: are happier, they're physically healthier, and they live longer
subtitles.chinese: 都会更加幸福，身体更加健康，寿命也更长，
subtitles.ipa: ɑːɹ hæpɪɚ, ðeɪɚ fɪzɪkli hɛlθiɚ, ænd ðeɪ lɪv lɔŋɡɚ

subtitles.english: than people who are less well connected.
subtitles.chinese: 相比那些社会联系较少的人而言。
subtitles.ipa: ðɐn piːpəl huː ɑːɹ lɛs wɛl kənɛktᵻd.

subtitles.english: And the experience of loneliness turns out to be toxic.
subtitles.chinese: 事实还证明，孤独是一种有害的体验。
subtitles.ipa: ænd ðɪ ɛkspiəɹɪəns ʌv loʊnlinəs tɜːnz aʊt təbi tɑːksɪk.
subtitles.english_html: Andtheexperienceoflonelinessturnsouttobetoxic.

subtitles.english: People who are more isolated than they want to be from others
subtitles.chinese: 那些与他人之间的隔绝程度超过自己意愿的人，
subtitles.ipa: piːpəl huː ɑːɹ mɔːɹ aɪsəleɪɾᵻd ðɐn ðeɪ wɔnt təbi fɹʌm ʌðɚz

subtitles.english: find that they are less happy,
subtitles.chinese: 往往会感到更加不幸福，
subtitles.ipa: faɪnd ðæt ðeɪ ɑːɹ lɛs hæpi,

subtitles.english: their health declines earlier in midlife,
subtitles.chinese: 他们的健康状况会在中年时期更早恶化，
subtitles.ipa: ðɛɹ hɛlθ dᵻklaɪnz ɜːlɪɚɹ ɪn mɪdlaɪf,

subtitles.english: their brain functioning declines sooner
subtitles.chinese: 大脑功能也会更早衰退，
subtitles.ipa: ðɛɹ bɹeɪn fʌŋkʃənɪŋ dᵻklaɪnz suːnɚ
subtitles.english_html: theirbrainfunctioningdeclinessooner

subtitles.english: and they live shorter lives than people who are not lonely.
subtitles.chinese: 寿命也比不孤独的人更短。
subtitles.ipa: ænd ðeɪ lɪv ʃɔːɹɾɚ laɪvz ðɐn piːpəl huː ɑːɹ nɑːt loʊnli.

subtitles.english: And the sad fact is that at any given time,
subtitles.chinese: 而一个令人难过的事实是，在任何一个时间点，
subtitles.ipa: ænd ðə sæd fækt ɪz ðæt æɾ ɛni ɡɪvən taɪm,

subtitles.english: more than one in five Americans will report that they're lonely.
subtitles.chinese: 超过五分之一的美国人都会表示自己感到孤独。
subtitles.ipa: mɔːɹ ðɐn wʌn ɪn faɪv ɐmɛɹɪkənz wɪl ɹᵻpɔːɹt ðæt ðeɪɚ loʊnli.

subtitles.english: And we know that you can be lonely in a crowd
subtitles.chinese: 我们也知道，即使身处人群之中，你仍然可能感到孤独，
subtitles.ipa: ænd wiː noʊ ðæt juː kæn biː loʊnli ɪn ɐ kɹaʊd

subtitles.english: and you can be lonely in a marriage,
subtitles.chinese: 即使身处婚姻之中，你也可能感到孤独。
subtitles.ipa: ænd juː kæn biː loʊnli ɪn ɐ mæɹɪdʒ,

subtitles.english: so the second big lesson that we learned
subtitles.chinese: 因此，我们得出的第二条重要结论
subtitles.ipa: soʊ ðə sɛkənd bɪɡ lɛsən ðæt wiː lɜːnd

subtitles.english: is that it's not just the number of friends you have,
subtitles.chinese: 是关键并不只是你有多少朋友，
subtitles.ipa: ɪz ðæt ɪts nɑːt dʒʌst ðə nʌmbɚɹ ʌv fɹɛndz juː hæv,

subtitles.english: and it's not whether or not you're in a committed relationship,
subtitles.chinese: 也不在于你是否处于一段稳定的亲密关系中，
subtitles.ipa: ænd ɪts nɑːt wɛðɚ ɔːɹ nɑːt jʊɹ ɪn ɐ kəmɪɾᵻd ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪp,
subtitles.english_html: andit'snotwhetherornotyou'reinacommittedrelationship,

subtitles.english: but it's the quality of your close relationships that matters.
subtitles.chinese: 真正重要的是亲密关系的质量。
subtitles.ipa: bʌt ɪts ðə kwɔlᵻɾi ʌv jʊɹ kloʊs ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪps ðæt mæɾɚz.
subtitles.english_html: butit'sthequalityofyourcloserelationshipsthatmatters.

subtitles.english: It turns out that living in the midst of conflict is really bad for our health.
subtitles.chinese: 事实证明，长期生活在冲突之中对健康非常不利。
subtitles.ipa: ɪt tɜːnz aʊt ðæt lɪvɪŋ ɪnðə mɪdst ʌv kɑːnflɪkt ɪz ɹiəli bæd fɔːɹ aʊɚ hɛlθ.
subtitles.english_html: Itturnsoutthatlivinginthemidstofconflictisreallybadforourhealth.

subtitles.english: High-conflict marriages, for example, without much affection,
subtitles.chinese: 例如，冲突频繁而又缺乏感情的婚姻，
subtitles.ipa: haɪkɑːnflɪkt mæɹɪdʒᵻz, fɔːɹ ɛɡzæmpəl, wɪðaʊt mʌtʃ ɐfɛkʃən,

subtitles.english: turn out to be very bad for our health, perhaps worse than getting divorced.
subtitles.chinese: 会严重损害健康，甚至可能比离婚更糟。
subtitles.ipa: tɜːn aʊt təbi vɛɹi bæd fɔːɹ aʊɚ hɛlθ, pɚhæps wɜːs ðɐn ɡɛɾɪŋ dᵻvɔːɹst.
subtitles.english_html: turnouttobeverybadforourhealth,perhapsworsethangettingdivorced.

subtitles.english: And living in the midst of good, warm relationships is protective.
subtitles.chinese: 而生活在良好、温暖的关系中，则能给我们带来保护。
subtitles.ipa: ænd lɪvɪŋ ɪnðə mɪdst ʌv ɡʊd, wɔːɹm ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪps ɪz pɹətɛktɪv.
subtitles.english_html: Andlivinginthemidstofgood,warmrelationshipsisprotective.

subtitles.english: Once we had followed our men all the way into their 80s,
subtitles.chinese: 在我们一路追踪这些男性，直到他们八十多岁之后，
subtitles.ipa: wʌns wiː hæd fɑːloʊd aʊɚ mɛn ɔːl ðə weɪ ɪntʊ ðɛɹ eɪɾi z,

subtitles.english: we wanted to look back at them at midlife
subtitles.chinese: 我们希望回过头去看看他们的中年时期，
subtitles.ipa: wiː wɔntᵻd tə lʊk bæk æt ðɛm æt mɪdlaɪf

subtitles.english: and to see if we could predict
subtitles.chinese: 看看我们能否预测，
subtitles.ipa: ænd tə siː ɪf wiː kʊd pɹɪdɪkt

subtitles.english: who was going to grow into a happy, healthy octogenarian
subtitles.chinese: 哪些人会成长为幸福、健康的八旬老人，
subtitles.ipa: huː wʌz ɡoʊɪŋ tə ɡɹoʊ ɪntʊ ɐ hæpi, hɛlθi ɑːktədʒənɛɹiən

subtitles.english: and who wasn't.
subtitles.chinese: 哪些人不会。
subtitles.ipa: ænd huː wʌzn̩t.

subtitles.english: And when we gathered together everything we knew about them
subtitles.chinese: 当我们汇总了自己掌握的关于他们的一切信息，
subtitles.ipa: ænd wɛn wiː ɡæðɚd təɡɛðɚɹ ɛvɹɪθɪŋ wiː nuː ɐbaʊt ðɛm

subtitles.english: at age 50,
subtitles.chinese: 也就是他们50岁时的所有资料后，
subtitles.ipa: æɾ eɪdʒ fɪfti,

subtitles.english: it wasn't their middle age cholesterol levels
subtitles.chinese: 能够预测他们将如何老去的，
subtitles.ipa: ɪt wʌzn̩t ðɛɹ mɪdəl eɪdʒ kəlɛstɚɹɑːl lɛvəlz
subtitles.english_html: itwasn'ttheirmiddleagecholesterollevels

subtitles.english: that predicted how they were going to grow old.
subtitles.chinese: 并不是他们中年时期的胆固醇水平。
subtitles.ipa: ðæt pɹɪdɪktᵻd haʊ ðeɪ wɜː ɡoʊɪŋ tə ɡɹoʊ oʊld.

subtitles.english: It was how satisfied they were in their relationships.
subtitles.chinese: 而是他们对自己的人际关系有多满意。
subtitles.ipa: ɪt wʌz haʊ sæɾɪsfaɪd ðeɪ wɜːɹ ɪn ðɛɹ ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪps.

subtitles.english: The people who were the most satisfied in their relationships at age 50
subtitles.chinese: 那些在50岁时对人际关系最满意的人，
subtitles.ipa: ðə piːpəl huː wɜː ðə moʊst sæɾɪsfaɪd ɪn ðɛɹ ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪps æɾ eɪdʒ fɪfti
subtitles.english_html: Thepeoplewhowerethemostsatisfiedintheirrelationshipsatage50

subtitles.english: were the healthiest at age 80.
subtitles.chinese: 到了80岁时身体也最健康。
subtitles.ipa: wɜː ðə hɛlθiɪst æɾ eɪdʒ eɪɾi.

subtitles.english: And good, close relationships seem to buffer us
subtitles.chinese: 良好而亲密的关系似乎还能帮助我们抵御
subtitles.ipa: ænd ɡʊd, kloʊs ɹᵻleɪʃənʃɪps siːm tə bʌfɚɹ ʌs
subtitles.english_html: Andgood,closerelationshipsseemtobufferus

subtitles.english: from some of the slings and arrows of getting old.
subtitles.chinese: 衰老过程中遭遇的一些痛苦与打击。

subtitles.ipa: ænd læstli, faɪv

subtitles.ipa: lɛt ɡoʊ ʌv nɑːt jɛt.

subtitles.chinese: 你知道，当我离开芝加哥的时候，我的生活其实挺好的，
subtitles.ipa: juː noʊ, wɛn aɪ lɛft ʃᵻkɑːɡoʊ, maɪ laɪf wʌz pɹɪɾi ɡʊd,

subtitles.ipa: ɪt dʒʌst wʌzn̩t ɡʊd ɪnʌf.

subtitles.english: If there is something you want to do, make a plan and act, but don't wait.

subtitles.ipa: ɪf ðɛɹ ɪz sʌmθɪŋ juː wɔnt tə duː, meɪk ɐ plæn ænd ækt, bʌt doʊnt weɪt.

subtitles.english: I still grieve for Hector, you know, it just comes in waves now.

subtitles.english: But it’s the phone call I can't make
subtitles.chinese: 但正是那通我再也打不出去的电话，
subtitles.ipa: bʌt ɪts ðə foʊn kɔːl aɪ kænt meɪk

episode.summary: 人总会高估自己的好结果，低估坏事发生在自己身上的概率。乐观能让人更幸福、更有动力，但如果完全忽视风险，也会带来错误决策。

subtitles.english: Thank you.
subtitles.chinese: 谢谢大家。
subtitles.ipa: θæŋk juː.

subtitles.english: I'm going to talk to you about optimism
subtitles.chinese: 我要和大家聊聊乐观主义。
subtitles.ipa: aɪm ɡoʊɪŋ tə tɔːk tə juː ɐbaʊt ɑːptɪmɪzəm

subtitles.english: or more precisely, the optimism bias.
subtitles.chinese: 或者更准确地说，是乐观偏见。
subtitles.ipa: ɔːɹ mɔːɹ pɹɪsaɪsli, ðɪ ɑːptɪmɪzəm baɪəs.
subtitles.english_html: ormoreprecisely,theoptimismbias.

subtitles.english: It's a cognitive illusion
subtitles.chinese: 这是一种认知错觉。
subtitles.ipa: ɪts ɐ kɑːɡnᵻtɪv ɪluːʒən
subtitles.english_html: It'sacognitiveillusion

subtitles.english: that we've been studying in my lab for the past few years,
subtitles.chinese: 过去几年，我们一直在实验室里研究它。
subtitles.ipa: ðæt wiːv bɪn stʌdiɪŋ ɪn maɪ læb fɚðə pæst fjuː jɪɹz,

subtitles.english: and 80 percent of us have it.
subtitles.chinese: 而我们当中有80%的人都有这种错觉。
subtitles.ipa: ænd eɪɾi pɚsɛnt ʌv ʌs hæv ɪt.

subtitles.english: It's our tendency to overestimate
subtitles.chinese: 它指的是我们倾向于高估
subtitles.ipa: ɪts aʊɚ tɛndənsi tʊ oʊvɚɹɛstᵻmeɪt

subtitles.english: our likelihood of experiencing good events in our lives
subtitles.chinese: 自己人生中遇到好事的可能性，
subtitles.ipa: aʊɚ laɪklihʊd ʌv ɛkspiəɹɪənsɪŋ ɡʊd ᵻvɛnts ɪn aʊɚ laɪvz
subtitles.english_html: ourlikelihoodofexperiencinggoodeventsinourlives

subtitles.english: and underestimate our likelihood of experiencing bad events.
subtitles.chinese: 同时低估自己遇到坏事的可能性。
subtitles.ipa: ænd ʌndɚɹɛstᵻmət aʊɚ laɪklihʊd ʌv ɛkspiəɹɪənsɪŋ bæd ᵻvɛnts.
subtitles.english_html: andunderestimateourlikelihoodofexperiencingbadevents.

subtitles.english: So we underestimate our likelihood of suffering from cancer,
subtitles.chinese: 所以，我们会低估自己患癌的可能性，
subtitles.ipa: soʊ wiː ʌndɚɹɛstᵻmeɪt aʊɚ laɪklihʊd ʌv sʌfɚɹɪŋ fɹʌm kænsɚ,
subtitles.english_html: Soweunderestimateourlikelihoodofsufferingfromcancer,

subtitles.english: being in a car accident.
subtitles.chinese: 也会低估自己遭遇车祸的可能性。
subtitles.ipa: biːɪŋ ɪn ɐ kɑːɹ æksɪdənt.

subtitles.english: We overestimate our longevity, our career prospects.
subtitles.chinese: 我们会高估自己的寿命，也会高估自己的职业前景。
subtitles.ipa: wiː oʊvɚɹɛstᵻmeɪt aʊɚ lɔndʒɛvᵻɾi, aʊɚ kɚɹɪɹ pɹɑːspɛkts.
subtitles.english_html: Weoverestimateourlongevity,ourcareerprospects.

subtitles.english: In short, we're more optimistic than realistic,
subtitles.chinese: 简而言之，我们往往比现实情况更乐观，
subtitles.ipa: ɪn ʃɔːɹt, wɪɹ mɔːɹ ɑːptɪmɪstɪk ðɐn ɹiːəlɪstɪk,

subtitles.english: but we are oblivious to the fact.
subtitles.chinese: 但我们自己却没有意识到这一点。
subtitles.ipa: bʌt wiː ɑːɹ əblɪviəs tə ðə fækt.

subtitles.english: Take marriage for example.
subtitles.chinese: 拿婚姻来说。
subtitles.ipa: teɪk mæɹɪdʒ fɔːɹ ɛɡzæmpəl.

subtitles.english: In the Western world, divorce rates are about 40 percent.
subtitles.chinese: 在西方世界，离婚率大约是40%。
subtitles.ipa: ɪnðə wɛstɚn wɜːld, dᵻvɔːɹs ɹeɪts ɑːɹ ɐbaʊt fɔːɹɾi pɚsɛnt.
subtitles.english_html: IntheWesternworld,divorceratesareabout40percent.

subtitles.english: That means that out of five married couples,
subtitles.chinese: 这意味着每五对已婚夫妻中，
subtitles.ipa: ðæt miːnz ðæt aʊɾəv faɪv mæɹid kʌpəlz,

subtitles.english: two will end up splitting their assets.
subtitles.chinese: 就有两对最终会分割财产、各奔东西。
subtitles.ipa: tuː wɪl ɛnd ʌp splɪɾɪŋ ðɛɹ æsɛts.

subtitles.english: But when you ask newlyweds about their own likelihood of divorce,
subtitles.chinese: 但是当你问新婚夫妇自己离婚的可能性有多大时，
subtitles.ipa: bʌt wɛn juː æsk nuːlɪwɛdz ɐbaʊt ðɛɹ oʊn laɪklihʊd ʌv dᵻvɔːɹs,
subtitles.english_html: Butwhenyouasknewlywedsabouttheirownlikelihoodofdivorce,

subtitles.english: they estimate it at zero percent.
subtitles.chinese: 他们的估计是零。
subtitles.ipa: ðeɪ ɛstᵻmeɪt ɪɾ æt ziəɹoʊ pɚsɛnt.

subtitles.english: And even divorce lawyers, who should really know better,
subtitles.chinese: 甚至连本该更清楚这一点的离婚律师，
subtitles.ipa: ænd iːvən dᵻvɔːɹs lɔɪɚz, huː ʃʊd ɹiəli noʊ bɛɾɚ,
subtitles.english_html: Andevendivorcelawyers,whoshouldreallyknowbetter,

subtitles.english: hugely underestimate their own likelihood of divorce.
subtitles.chinese: 也会大大低估自己离婚的可能性。
subtitles.ipa: hjuːdʒli ʌndɚɹɛstᵻmət ðɛɹ oʊn laɪklihʊd ʌv dᵻvɔːɹs.
subtitles.english_html: hugelyunderestimatetheirownlikelihoodofdivorce.

subtitles.english: So it turns out that optimists are not less likely to divorce,
subtitles.chinese: 所以事实证明，乐观主义者并不更不容易离婚，
subtitles.ipa: soʊ ɪt tɜːnz aʊt ðæt ɑːptɪmɪsts ɑːɹ nɑːt lɛs laɪkli tə dᵻvɔːɹs,
subtitles.english_html: Soitturnsoutthatoptimistsarenotlesslikelytodivorce,

subtitles.english: but they are more likely to remarry.
subtitles.chinese: 但他们更有可能再婚。
subtitles.ipa: bʌt ðeɪ ɑːɹ mɔːɹ laɪkli tə ɹᵻmæɹi.

subtitles.english: In the words of Samuel Johnson,
subtitles.chinese: 用 Samuel Johnson 的话来说，
subtitles.ipa: ɪnðə wɜːdz ʌv sæmjuːl dʒɑːnsən,

subtitles.english: "Remarriage is the triumph of hope over experience."
subtitles.chinese: '再婚，是希望战胜经验的胜利。'
subtitles.ipa: "ɹᵻmæɹɪdʒ ɪz ðə tɹaɪʌmf ʌv hoʊp oʊvɚɹ ɛkspiəɹɪəns."
subtitles.english_html: "Remarriageisthetriumphofhopeoverexperience."

subtitles.english: So if we're married, we're more likely to have kids.
subtitles.chinese: 所以，如果我们结了婚，我们更有可能会有孩子。
subtitles.ipa: soʊ ɪf wɪɹ mæɹid, wɪɹ mɔːɹ laɪkli tə hæv kɪdz.

subtitles.english: And we all think our kids will be especially talented.
subtitles.chinese: 而我们都觉得自己的孩子会特别有天赋。
subtitles.ipa: ænd wiː ɔːl θɪŋk aʊɚ kɪdz wɪl biː ɪspɛʃəli tæləntᵻd.

subtitles.english: This, by the way, is my two-year-old nephew, Guy.
subtitles.chinese: 顺便说一下，这是我两岁的侄子 Guy。
subtitles.ipa: ðɪs, baɪ ðə weɪ, ɪz maɪ tuːjɪɹoʊld nɛfjuː, ɡaɪ.

subtitles.english: And I just want to make it absolutely clear
subtitles.chinese: 我只想非常明确地说明一点，
subtitles.ipa: ænd aɪ dʒʌst wɔnt tə meɪk ɪɾ æbsəluːtli klɪɹ

subtitles.english: that he's a really bad example of the optimism bias,
subtitles.chinese: 他实在不是乐观偏见的好例子，
subtitles.ipa: ðæt hiːz ɐ ɹiəli bæd ɛɡzæmpəl ʌvðɪ ɑːptɪmɪzəm baɪəs,
subtitles.english_html: thathe'sareallybadexampleoftheoptimismbias,

subtitles.english: because he is in fact uniquely talented.
subtitles.chinese: 因为事实上，他确实有独一无二的天赋。
subtitles.ipa: bɪkʌz hiː ɪz ɪn fækt juːniːkli tæləntᵻd.

subtitles.english: And I'm not alone.
subtitles.chinese: 而且不只是我这样想。
subtitles.ipa: ænd aɪm nɑːt ɐloʊn.

subtitles.english: Out of four British people, three said
subtitles.chinese: 每四个英国人当中，就有三个人说
subtitles.ipa: aʊɾəv fɔːɹ bɹɪɾɪʃ piːpəl, θɹiː sɛd

subtitles.english: that they were optimistic about the future of their own families.
subtitles.chinese: 他们对自己家庭的未来感到乐观。
subtitles.ipa: ðæt ðeɪ wɜːɹ ɑːptɪmɪstɪk ɐbaʊt ðə fjuːtʃɚɹ ʌv ðɛɹ oʊn fæmɪliz.
subtitles.english_html: thattheywereoptimisticaboutthefutureoftheirownfamilies.

subtitles.english: That's 75 percent.
subtitles.chinese: 也就是75%。
subtitles.ipa: ðæts sɛvənti faɪv pɚsɛnt.

subtitles.english: But only 30 percent said
subtitles.chinese: 但只有30%的人说，
subtitles.ipa: bʌt oʊnli θɜːɾi pɚsɛnt sɛd

subtitles.english: that they thought families in general
subtitles.chinese: 他们认为总体来看，家庭的状况
subtitles.ipa: ðæt ðeɪ θɔːt fæmɪliz ɪn dʒɛnɚɹəl

subtitles.english: are doing better than a few generations ago.
subtitles.chinese: 比几代人以前更好了。
subtitles.ipa: ɑːɹ duːɪŋ bɛɾɚ ðænə fjuː dʒɛnɚɹeɪʃənz ɐɡoʊ.

subtitles.english: And this is a really important point,
subtitles.chinese: 这是一个非常重要的点，
subtitles.ipa: ænd ðɪs ɪz ɐ ɹiəli ɪmpɔːɹtənt pɔɪnt,

subtitles.english: because we're optimistic about ourselves,
subtitles.chinese: 因为我们对自己很乐观，
subtitles.ipa: bɪkʌz wɪɹ ɑːptɪmɪstɪk ɐbaʊt aʊɚsɛlvz,

subtitles.english: we're optimistic about our kids,
subtitles.chinese: 对自己的孩子很乐观，
subtitles.ipa: wɪɹ ɑːptɪmɪstɪk ɐbaʊt aʊɚ kɪdz,

subtitles.english: we're optimistic about our families,
subtitles.chinese: 对自己的家庭也很乐观，
subtitles.ipa: wɪɹ ɑːptɪmɪstɪk ɐbaʊt aʊɚ fæmɪliz,

subtitles.english: but we're not so optimistic about the guy sitting next to us,
subtitles.chinese: 但我们对坐在旁边的那个人就没那么乐观了，
subtitles.ipa: bʌt wɪɹ nɑːt soʊ ɑːptɪmɪstɪk ɐbaʊt ðə ɡaɪ sɪɾɪŋ nɛkst tʊ ʌs,

subtitles.english: and we're somewhat pessimistic
subtitles.chinese: 而且我们对
subtitles.ipa: ænd wɪɹ sʌmwʌt pɛsɪmɪstɪk
subtitles.english_html: andwe'resomewhatpessimistic

subtitles.english: about the fate of our fellow citizens and the fate of our country.
subtitles.chinese: 同胞的命运和国家的命运多少有些悲观。
subtitles.ipa: ɐbaʊt ðə feɪt ʌv aʊɚ fɛloʊ sɪɾɪzənz ænd ðə feɪt ʌv aʊɚ kʌntɹi.
subtitles.english_html: aboutthefateofourfellowcitizensandthefateofourcountry.

subtitles.english: But private optimism about our own personal future
subtitles.chinese: 但是，我们对自己个人未来的私人乐观，
subtitles.ipa: bʌt pɹaɪvət ɑːptɪmɪzəm ɐbaʊt aʊɚɹ oʊn pɜːsənəl fjuːtʃɚ
subtitles.english_html: Butprivateoptimismaboutourownpersonalfuture

subtitles.english: remains persistent.
subtitles.chinese: 却始终存在。
subtitles.ipa: ɹᵻmeɪnz pɚsɪstənt.

subtitles.english: And it doesn't mean that we think things will magically turn out okay,
subtitles.chinese: 这并不是说我们觉得事情会神奇地自己变好，

subtitles.english: but rather that we have the unique ability to make it so.
subtitles.chinese: 而是说，我们相信自己有独特的能力让事情变好。

subtitles.english: Now I'm a scientist, I do experiments.
subtitles.chinese: 我是科学家，我做实验。
subtitles.ipa: naʊ aɪm ɐ saɪəntɪst, aɪ duː ɛkspɛɹɪmənts.

subtitles.english: So to show you what I mean,
subtitles.chinese: 所以为了让大家明白我的意思，
subtitles.ipa: soʊ tə ʃoʊ juː wʌt aɪ miːn,

subtitles.english: I'm going to do an experiment here with you.
subtitles.chinese: 我想在这里和大家做一个实验。
subtitles.ipa: aɪm ɡoʊɪŋ tə duː ɐn ɛkspɛɹɪmənt hɪɹ wɪð juː.

subtitles.english: So I'm going to give you a list of abilities and characteristics,
subtitles.chinese: 我会给大家列出一组能力和特质，

subtitles.english: and I want you to think for each of these abilities
subtitles.chinese: 我希望大家针对每一项能力想一想，
subtitles.ipa: ænd aɪ wɔnt juː tə θɪŋk fɔːɹ iːtʃ əv ðiːz ɐbɪləɾiz

subtitles.english: where you stand relative to the rest of the population.
subtitles.chinese: 自己和其他人相比处在什么位置。
subtitles.ipa: wɛɹ juː stænd ɹɛlətɪv tə ðə ɹɛst ʌvðə pɑːpjʊleɪʃən.

subtitles.english: The first one is getting along well with others.
subtitles.chinese: 第一项是与他人相处融洽的能力。
subtitles.ipa: ðə fɜːst wʌn ɪz ɡɛɾɪŋ ɐlɔŋ wɛl wɪð ʌðɚz.

subtitles.english: Who here believes they're at the bottom 25 percent?
subtitles.chinese: 在座有谁认为自己处在后25%？
subtitles.ipa: huː hɪɹ bᵻliːvz ðeɪɚɹ æt ðə bɑːɾəm twɛnti faɪv pɚsɛnt?

subtitles.english: Okay, that's about 10 people out of 1,500.
subtitles.chinese: 好，大约是1500人里的10个人。
subtitles.ipa: oʊkeɪ, ðæts ɐbaʊt tɛn piːpəl aʊɾəv wʌn,faɪvhʌndɹɪd.

subtitles.english: Who believes they're at the top 25 percent?
subtitles.chinese: 有谁认为自己处在前25%？
subtitles.ipa: huː bᵻliːvz ðeɪɚɹ æt ðə tɑːp twɛnti faɪv pɚsɛnt?
